stories.title: Don't fall for this - how to protect yourself from AI scams
stories.brief: Trading standards officers say AI is "super-charging" existing scams through clones and fake websites.

stories.title: Mission set to blast off for Mars to grab a piece of its moon
stories.brief: A spacecraft is set to launch on an ambitious mission to bring 10g of Martian moon dust back to Earth.

stories.title: Carney says 4 service members killed and dozens injured in fire at Alberta military base
stories.brief: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney described the incident as one of the worst peacetime tragedies for Canada's military on domestic soil.(Image credit: John Ulan)

stories.title: Four soldiers dead, dozens injured in fire at Canada military base
stories.brief: Four soldiers were killed and dozens injured in a fire at a military base in Alberta province, one of the worst peacetime tragedies to hit Canada’s armed forces on home soil, Prime Minister Mark Carney said on Sunday.

stories.title: Khawaja Asif raises alarm over bureaucrats' 'exodus' to Portugal
stories.brief: Defence Minister Khawaja Asif on Sunday questioned the commitment of senior bureaucrats to Pakistan, alleging that a significant number of government officers had planned to settle abroad while still serving the country.

stories.title: Bilawal slams PTI's Afridi over K-P security, says PPP ready to fight terrorists
stories.brief: The PPP chairman said his party had once been at the forefront of the fight against terrorism, but the struggle had since become a collective responsibility, with citizens across the country striving for peace.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz stresses equal opportunities in education to realize Quaid's vision
stories.brief: Recalling the initiative’s origins during his tenure as Punjab chief minister, PM Shehbaz questioned why children from affluent families could attend elite institutions while millions of equally talented children from poor households could not access comparable education.

stories.title: FM Dar, Iranian FM discuss regional situation, OIC meeting in Baghdad
stories.brief: In a post on X, the FO said the two leaders also discussed the next meeting of the R-4 grouping, comprising Pakistan, Egypt, Turkiye and Saudi Arabia, during a telephone conversation. “The two leaders exchanged views on recent regional developments," the ministry added.

stories.title: EU tariffs aimed at China hitting Ukraine, steel boss says
stories.brief: The boss of one of Ukraine's biggest steel companies says the country has been "bundled together" in measures aimed at curbing cheap imports.

stories.title: Home sellers cut asking prices on 3,000 properties a day
stories.brief: More property asking prices are being cut than at any time in 15 years, data shared with the BBC shows.

stories.title: Inside Chicago's battle against the synthetic drugs flooding the US
stories.brief: The BBC's Quentin Sommerville reports from Chicago, where communities are battling a new wave of synthetic drugs.

stories.title: Turning the tides: Could hidden sea power energise our coastal towns?
stories.brief: Engineer David Mummery has developed a tidal energy generator that he says can change lives for people living in coastal communities.

stories.title: How day of protests unfolded as disorder breaks out across France
stories.brief: Demonstrations across the country turned violent, with cars and buildings set alight and shops ransacked.

stories.title: 'Was not sure I'll make it ​out alive': Captain of flydubai flight to Tel Aviv recalls blocking axe blows from co-pilot
stories.brief: The captain of a flydubai flight who was attacked by a co-pilot who intended to crash the plane has described blocking axe blows to the head and screaming for help as he reached for a knob to open the cockpit door. The suspect, an Omani national, was transferred to the UAE, flydubai’s home country.

stories.title: Northampton beat Cardiff for only English win of Champions Cup openers
stories.brief: Northampton edge to a nervy Champions Cup pool win against tenacious Cardiff at Franklin's Gardens.

stories.title: Bilawal says KP governor's rule could end if opposition engages with Centre on counterterrorism
stories.brief: PPP Chairperson Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari said on Sunday that if the opposition was willing to fight against terrorism and engage with the Centre on a plan, governor’s rule and emergency imposed in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa could end.

stories.title: Mbeumo offers Carrick solace as Man Utd winless run goes on
stories.brief: Michael Carrick said he had his headphones on this week so didn't hear the noise around Manchester United, but a 1-1 draw at Leeds means it is six games without a win.

stories.title: 8 India-sponsored terrorists killed in Quetta, Khuzdar, Nushki districts: ISPR
stories.brief: Security forces have killed eight “India-sponsored” terrorists during three intelligence-based operations conducted in the Quetta, Nushki and Khuzdar districts of Balochistan, Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) said on Sunday. Separately, during a sanitisation operation in Nushki district, security forces busted a terrorist hideout and “after an intense fire exchange, two India-sponsored terrorists were sent to hell”.
